seed.title: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
seed.summary: A minimalist indie horror adventure inspired by Thai folklore. Play as a wandering child spirit guided by faint memories through temples, canals, and moonlit alleys to uncover the truth behind your unfinished story.
seed.body:
Overview

Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit is a story-driven horror adventure that blends light platforming, tactile puzzles, and environmental storytelling. Set in a stylized, hand-crafted vision of Thailand, you traverse abandoned schoolyards, shrine-filled courtyards, and underground catacombs while evading vengeful entities drawn from local myth.

Core Pillars

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate side-scrolling spaces with layered parallax, dynamic light, and minimalist UI that keeps you immersed.
  • Thai Folklore, Reimagined: From temple bells to spirit-offering altars, mechanics and puzzles tie back to cultural rituals and objects.
  • Quiet Tension: No jump-scare spam. Threat builds through silhouette, sound design, and timing—then releases with clever puzzle payoffs.
  • Readable Challenges: Puzzle prompts, symbol language, and diegetic hints are conveyed through the environment.

Gameplay

  • Light–Shadow Puzzles: Align lanterns, reflect moonbeams, and disrupt spirit wards to open new paths.
  • Stealth Beats: Hold your breath behind prayer flags or slip under offering tables to avoid patrolling spirits.
  • Chase Setpieces: Scripted pursuits through collapsing corridors and canal bridges, tuned for clarity and fairness.

Art & Audio

Painterly materials, soft volumetrics, and a restrained color palette emphasize silhouette and mood. The score blends traditional instruments with modern ambient design; diegetic cues (bells, cicadas, chanting) serve both theme and mechanics.

Accessibility

  • High-contrast UI and readable fonts (Noto Sans).
  • Optional puzzle hints and adjustable QTE windows.
  • Color-safe feedback and reduced-motion option for camera effects.
